title: Ladies' Manual of Art
content: The Ladies' Manual of Art was published in 1887.The title page appears at first to be about dainty, decorative artistic pastimes—until you get to the end and it mentions taxidermy.The final chapters give detailed descriptions of skinning and stuffing serpents and crocodiles, preserving spiders, and dealing with the skins of large mammals.----Ladies' Manual of Art at Archive.org
